title: Session chat page custom view provider: lazy-load ExperimentCustomViewProvider because @a2ui is ESM-only
answers: Why is the Sessions chat page bundle large or failing to load when custom views are off?
Why does ExperimentCustomViewProvider load through React.lazy in the session page?
How do I import the custom view provider without pulling @a2ui into the chat-session route?
body:
Path: mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/pages/experiment-chat-sessions/single-chat-view/ExperimentSingleChatSessionPage.tsx:LazyExperimentCustomViewProvider. This module-level lazy import is the only place the session chat route loads the custom-view provider, which is used by ContextProviders.
Rule: Import ExperimentCustomViewProvider via a dynamic import wrapped in React.lazy and rendered inside React.Suspense, rather than a static import, so @a2ui (ESM-only, pulled in transitively) is only added to the graph when the feature is enabled.
Symptom: (omitted; this is a bundling convention.)
Constraints: Keep the Suspense fallback in place when wrapping the lazy provider; the fallback is a GenericSkeleton.
applies: Frontend imports of ExperimentCustomViewProvider from route-level pages in the MLflow JS app.
says: The chat sessions page fails to load when custom views are disabled.
Opening a chat session takes too long because the initial page download is huge.
Do not load custom view code on the chat session screen when disabled.
The chat session view crashes when loading without custom views enabled in our environment.
search: In frontend route-level pages of the MLflow JS app, LazyExperimentCustomViewProvider in mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/pages/experiment-chat-sessions/single-chat-view/ExperimentSingleChatSessionPage.tsx imports ExperimentCustomViewProvider via a dynamic import wrapped in React.lazy and rendered inside React.Suspense instead of a static import. This ensures transitively imported ESM-only @a2ui is only pulled into the module graph when the feature is enabled. A Suspense fallback using GenericSkeleton must remain in place.
